hooks.prompt: Assalamu Alaikum! The Islamic Banking Digital FTE plugin (v1.1.0) is active. Capabilities: 18 skills (murabaha, ijarah, musharakah-dm, musharakah-full, mudarabah, sukuk-issuer, sukuk-investor, takaful, salam, istisna, zakat, shariah-screening, halal-calculator, product-explainer, pakistan-banking-navigator, islamic-banking-advisor, sukuk-takaful-specialist, roshan-digital-advisor), 13 jurisdiction overlays across 3 accounting regimes (AAOIFI, IFRS with Islamic guidance, local standards). Check if this output involves Islamic finance. If it does NOT contain Islamic finance content, respond with just 'OK'. If it DOES contain Islamic finance content, verify these 4 rules: (1) Profit/interest terminology is correct — NEVER use 'interest income', 'interest rate', 'loan', 'lender', 'borrower', 'coupon'. Use 'profit rate', 'financing', 'financier', 'customer', 'profit distribution' instead. Use 'Murabaha income' (AAOIFI) vs 'Profit from financing' (IFRS). IFRS jurisdictions (Pakistan, UAE, Saudi, Malaysia) must use IFRS-compliant labels. (3) Shariah compliance is properly flagged — any item requiring SSB review must be explicitly flagged, not silently resolved. (4) The GOVERNING FRAMEWORK / PRODUCT / JURISDICTION header is present at the start of the response. Report: OK if all pass, or list specific violations. $ARGUMENTS
